description: This file defines functions for generating unique IDs using custom alphabets, specifically the 'nanoid' function, which creates a random ID string of specified length, and 'customAlphabet' for creating customized identifier generators.

methods.name: customAlphabet
methods.description: Creates a function that generates IDs of a specified size using a given alphabet.

methods.name: nanoid
methods.description: Generates a random ID string of a given size using a predefined URL-safe alphabet.
